product_metadata.title: Zenna Home Extra Wide Hanging Over-the-Shower Caddy, Bronze
features: VALUABLE EXTRA-WIDE SHOWER STORAGE: Rust-resistant shower caddy fits over showerhead to provide storage for more of your bath essentials
EASY TO INSTALL: Includes non-slip collar and suction cups for easy installation with no slipping and swaying
WITH 2 EXTRA WIDE BASKETS TO MAXIMIZE STORAGE: Provides storage for large bottles and other bath essentials
ROOM FOR ALL YOUR BATH ESSENTIALS: Includes hanging storage holders and hooks for razors, shower poufs and more
RICH FINISH RESISTS RUST: Bronze finish is rust resistant
description: Maximize storage of your bath essentials with this extra-wide Zenna Home over-the-shower caddy. Featuring two deep extra-wide storage baskets, this rust-resistant caddy has plenty of room to hold large bottles plus assorted other bath and shower items. The caddy is easy to securely install over most showerheads, thanks to its non-slip collar and included suction cups that prevent slipping and swaying. Hooks and holders for razor storage, shower poufs and more are at the caddy bottom.
